Your holdings: Many positions are flashing 'SELL' and are below their stops. Bottom line: Your concentrated, leveraged tech portfolio is facing strong headwinds; aggressive risk management is paramount.
plays: Respect your stops: Trim QQQ (current 656.1, stop 670) and SMH (current 463.96, stop 540) as they are already below their set levels.

Address leveraged decay: Seriously consider trimming or exiting your deeply underwater leveraged positions like SOXL (-79.55%) and MUU (-62.95%). Their stops are effectively meaningless at these levels.
Consider a hedge: The scanner shows SQQQ (inverse QQQ) as an ACCUMULATE long setup (entry 47.1-46.92, stop 46.25). This could offer some downside protection for your QQQ exposure.
